notes.title: First Big Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Q3gXf3PkHko;full][/previewyoutube]
Three new types of Droppets have been added for the first Update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334158/ff96a7792c46c634d2f049b3540d8f784d96d4a8.png
They are only available for the hardest difficulty.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334158/66e8e2474b0faba2b7023b4e1c1b8f2fb85e7b63.png
The Mice always come in groups of two or three.
Careful where you’re dropping them for they won’t stick together.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334158/1fe6d05874558a4026e09c19b40d3e04396fc91d.png
The Rock Tortoise falls harder but is harder to move.
You can mess the pile if you badly angle its drop.
You can use it to keep the Droppets on the Panda's head by holding the edges.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334158/494335b73c7002143b66317cebe3d54407f9f32d.png
The Owl will fly away after panicking twice.
You will not lose if it flies away and the meter won’t lose any progress.


Also in this update, the new Arcade mode was added!
This mode allows a quick overview of the Friendly Droppets gameplay for new players.
A new Achievement can be unlocked by completing Arcade mode.

To stay coherent with the new Arcade mode, the Level Select menu was renamed Challenges.
